kootas.name: Ganam
kootas.rule: Same gana: uttama; Deva–Manushya: madhyama; Rakshasa with a different gana: no agreement

kootas.name: Yoni
kootas.rule: Hostile animal pair (horse–buffalo, elephant–lion, sheep–monkey, serpent–mongoose, dog–deer, cat–rat, cow–tiger): no agreement; same animal: uttama

kootas.name: Rasi
kootas.rule: Count girl→boy rashi: same rashi or beyond the 6th agrees

kootas.name: Rasi Athipathi
kootas.rule: Rashi lords same or mutual friends: uttama; neutral involved: madhyama; enmity either way: no agreement (naisargika maitri)

kootas.name: Vasiyam
kootas.rule: Either person's rashi is vasya to the other's (published vasya table)

kootas.name: Rajju
kootas.rule: Both nakshatras in the same rajju group: Rajju dosha (no agreement)

kootas.name: Vedhai
kootas.rule: Nakshatras form a published vedha pair: Vedha dosha (no agreement)

source: Standard published Tamil/Kerala 10-porutham tables (Dinam, Ganam, Mahendram, Stree Deergham, Yoni, Rasi, Rasi Athipathi, Vasiyam, Rajju, Vedhai) as reproduced in Tamil panchanga porutham explainers (e.g. hindutone.com "Porutham Explained", astroved.com "Vasya Porutham" table); kuta list as in B.V. Raman, "Muhurtha (Electional Astrology)", chapter on marriage; rashi-lord friendship by BPHS naisargika maitri (engine table).
conventionNotes: Dinam uses the Tamil count list {2,4,6,8,9,11,13,15,18,20,24,26}; the Dashakoota variant uses the remainder-after-9 rule (which also accepts counts 17, 22 and 27).
All counts are inclusive, from the girl's (bride's) nakshatra or rashi to the boy's (groom's); same = 1.
Inputs are the Moon nakshatra and rashi of each chart, computed by the engine with the active AstrologyConfig (ayanamsa).
Gana and yoni tables are the same as the Ashtakoota tables (src/matchmaking, imported unchanged).
Gana: some Tamil texts accept a Rakshasa boy with a Deva/Manushya girl, or apply exceptions by star count; not applied.
Stree Deergham: some astrologers grade a count above 9 as moderate (madhyama); the default here is count > 13 only.
Yoni: some reports additionally grade by yoni gender (e.g. male–male); not applied — only the seven hostile pairs fail.
Rasi: some texts fail 6/8 (shashtashtaka) and 2/12 (dvirdvadasa) separately, with lord-friendship exceptions; reported as flags only, not used in the match.
Rasi Athipathi: uses naisargika (natural) relationships from the engine table; some texts fail only mutual enmity.
Vasya table per astroved.com; some Tamil panchangas give Simha → Makara, Thula → Kanni + Makara, Vrischika → Kataka only.
Rajju: 5-fold (Siro, Kantha, Nabhi, Kati, Pada) Tamil grouping; Kerala practice also uses a 3-fold (Prathama/Madhya/Antya) grouping and ascending/descending sub-divisions — not applied.
Same-nakshatra exceptions (e.g. Rohini, Ardra, Pushya, Magha, Hasta, Shravana treated as acceptable when shared) are not applied.
